title: Rabbah bar Livai

paragraphs: In [Pesachim 40b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.40b.3) and [Avodah Zarah 65b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.65b.8) he raised an objection to Rava; Rava was embarrassed and retracted.

In [Pesachim 110a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.110a.10) they said that Rava bar Livai was harmed (because he drank in pairs), and Rava said this was because he had objected to him in the lecture. Hyman records two halakhot from him: in [Yevamot 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.12b.7) Rabbah bar Livai said, “It has a limit; before this time she does not conceive,” etc.; and in [Niddah 46b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.46b.12) he said, “Her husband annuls for her at every moment.”[^2]

notes.text: The supplied מתבערת differs from saved Davidson Yevamot 12b’s מתעברת, “she does not conceive.” The English follows the conception sense; no physical letter history is asserted. Rava in the supplied Pesachim episode is retained against Rabbah in the other halakhot.

The linked objections to Rava name Rabbah bar Livai. The linked Pesachim 110a instead has Rava bar Livai in the pairs episode and plain Rava explaining the harm. Yevamot uses the verb “conceive,” while the surviving supplied letters are recorded above.
